decisions.statement: A name set on the line naming the call names the directory a run writes a CPU profile into.
The profiler is switched by a name set on the line rather than by a file the machine holds.
A name set to what is no directory profiles nothing and says so.
A run with that name unset carries no profiling flag.

definition: the `akasha` name on PATH, handing what follows it to the dispatcher in the checkout
